decisions.decision: daily-pages query now hydrates from SSR initialDailyPages and gates auto-open on isSuccess (dailyReady), not isFetched (dailyFetched)
decisions.rationale: Under the global refetchOnMount:false, the daily-pages query uniquely had empty initialData:[] and never refetched, so prior-session pages never appeared and isFetched never became true (which also broke shouldAutoOpenToday). SSR hydration + isSuccess fixes both.

decisions.decision: in-document SSE route awaits both jarvis_turns inserts (userTurnPersist + assistantPersist) via Promise.allSettled before controller.close()
decisions.rationale: Fire-and-forget void promises get dropped on Vercel: the function freezes at stream close, so the processing turn never landed in jarvis_turns and never appeared in the JARVIS console.
